title: Kissed Charred Norwegian Veal Casserole
description: A comforting Norwegian dish featuring veal, mother-sauce-base, and a satvik-friendly cheese pull, charred to perfection. This casserole is a hearty and satisfying meal for any occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the oil over medium-high heat and char the veal cutlets for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Remove the veal from the skillet and set it aside, then add the chopped onion and carrots and cook until they are tender.
In a separate saucepan, heat the mother sauce over low heat.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked veal, onion, carrots, flour, salt, and pepper, and stir until the flour is well combined.
Add the heated mother sauce to the bowl and stir until the mixture is well coated.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with the shredded cheese.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
